summary: With our expert-led course, master the craft of handling geographic databases. Learn about best practices in effective data handling and analysis.
lede: Geospatial database management covers designing, maintaining and tuning spatial data systems for analysis and reliable access. For database administrators, spatial data engineers, GIS architects and analysts, this training addresses the practical work of building and supporting shared spatial data repositories. Learners practice schema design, spatial SQL and query tuning, plus automated data validation and loading, indexing and access controls.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for technical professionals responsible for the architecture, maintenance, and optimization of spatial data repositories within enterprise environments.
modules: Spatial Data Modeling and Schema Design
Advanced Spatial SQL and Query Optimization
Cloud-Native Spatial Databases and Integration Strategy
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of standard SQL (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY) and experience using desktop GIS software such as QGIS or ArcGIS® Pro. No prior experience with spatial database administration is required, though familiarity with relational database concepts is highly recommended.
